peopleAlsoAsk.question: How to become MBCT certified?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet:
Requirements for MBCT Teacher Certification:
 1. Will have been granted the MBCT Teacher Qualification.
 2. Will have taught a minimum of three MBCT 8-week courses beyond the two required for Teacher Qualification status.
 3. Completion of the Advanced MBCT Teacher Training Intensive (MBCT ATTI).
peopleAlsoAsk.title: MBCT Teacher Qualification & Certification | UCSD MBPTI

peopleAlsoAsk.question: What's the difference between MBCT and MBSR?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: MBSR is a general stress-reduction program applicable to a broad range of people dealing with stress or health issues, whereas MBCT is a therapy protocol that explicitly targets the thought patterns that underlie depression and anxiety (3).
peopleAlsoAsk.title: Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy & Stress Reduction (MBCT/MBSR)

peopleAlsoAsk.question: How to become a MBCT therapist?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: You are expected to have: knowledge of mindfulness-based approaches, and to have attended at least one face-to-face or online eight-week MBCT-L (Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy for Life) course run by an experienced provider. The Oxford Mindfulness Foundation offers many courses.
